request: mix: CSVの指定列のBase64セルを復号してCSVで出力する / CSVをファイルまたは標準入力から読み、-c で指定した列番号（1始まり、カンマ区切りで複数可）のセルをBase64として復号し、同じ形のCSVを標準出力へ出す。-u を付けるとURLセーフ形式も受け付ける。復号できないセルや有効なUTF-8でないセルは元の値のまま残し、改行を含む結果は正しく引用符で囲む。例: 行「1,SGVsbG8=」を -c 2 で処理すると「1,Hello」になる。コマンド名は b64col

spec.name: b64col
spec.summary: b64col reads CSV from a file or stdin and Base64-decodes the cells in the chosen columns, writing CSV to stdout.
behavior: B1: The input is the single file argument, or stdin if there is no file argument. More than one file argument is a usage error: print "b64col: too many arguments" to stderr, exit 2.

B2: -c is required. If it is missing or empty, print "b64col: -c is required" to stderr and exit 2. Split the value on commas; each part must be a base-10 integer >= 1, otherwise print "b64col: invalid column list" to stderr and exit 2. Duplicate numbers are allowed and have no extra effect.

B3: Parse the input with encoding/csv, FieldsPerRecord = -1 (rows may have different numbers of fields), default quoting rules, no trimming. Read all records before writing anything. On a parse error or an unreadable file, print "b64col: " followed by the error text to stderr, write nothing to stdout, exit 1.

B4: For each row and each selected column that exists in that row, try to decode the cell with base64.StdEncoding (padding required, no whitespace trimming). If -u is given and that fails, also try base64.URLEncoding. A cell containing a CR or LF character is never decoded. Without -u, the characters - and _ make a cell undecodable.
B5: If decoding succeeds and the decoded bytes are valid UTF-8 (utf8.Valid), the cell is replaced by the decoded text. Otherwise the cell keeps its original value. An empty cell stays empty.
B6: Rows that have fewer fields than a selected column number are left unchanged for that column; other columns and rows keep their shape and order.
B7: Write all rows with encoding/csv Writer (comma separator, LF line endings), so fields with newlines, commas or quotes are quoted as needed. Flush, then exit 0.
B8: Empty input produces no output and exit 0.

cases.name: invalid utf8 kept, short row passed, multiple columns
